services.name: Historic Home Tour
services.desc: On Saturday & Sunday, October 10th - 11th, 2026, the streets of Old Torrance will be buzzing with visitors from all around the South Bay, as the Torrance Historical Society is hosting their biennial Original Fall Tour of Historic Homes. YOU can tour the inside of a half-dozen homes, and see how others have renovated, updated, and decorated their historic homes to accommodate today’s life-style, yet managed to preserve the charming architecture and characteristics of the past. The homes on the tour reflect an eclectic mix - from Spanish Colonial Revival to Craftsman to Mission Revival to Tudor Revival - which characterize and add to the charm of Old Torrance - founded 1912.
